en_meaning: A hobby or minor occupation pursued in addition to one's main work
vi_meaning: Sở thích phụ, nghề tay trái
example_sentence: Although he derived his steady income from a mundane post in the municipal land registry, his true passion was his avocation as an amateur entomologist, which found him traversing the Appalachian ridges every autumn to catalog elusive moth species.

en_meaning: To assert or confess openly and directly
vi_meaning: Tuyên bố công khai, thừa nhận thẳng thắn
example_sentence: Standing before the hostile parliamentary committee, the reformist senator refused to recant his earlier writings, choosing instead to avow his unwavering commitment to universal suffrage.

en_meaning: Kind and friendly toward a younger person, like an uncle
vi_meaning: Ân cần như chú bác, thân thiện và độ lượng
example_sentence: With his warm laughter, ready humor, and avuncular demeanor, the elder statesman possessed a rare gift for putting intimidated young diplomats at ease during tense multilateral summits.

en_meaning: A feeling of reverential respect mixed with fear or wonder
vi_meaning: Sự kính sợ, lòng tôn kính xen lẫn kinh ngạc
example_sentence: Gazing into the unfathomable depths of the oceanic trench through the submersible's viewport, the oceanographers were hushed into profound awe by the eerie luminescence of undiscovered hydrothermal fauna.

en_meaning: Away from the appropriate, planned, or expected course
vi_meaning: Hỏng bét, chệch hướng ngoài dự tính
example_sentence: The military expedition went disastrously awry when unseasonal blizzards choked the mountain passes, cutting off the supply train and stranding the vanguard deep inside hostile territory.

en_meaning: A statement or proposition which is regarded as being self-evidently true
vi_meaning: Tiên đề, chân lý hiển nhiên
example_sentence: Classical economics long operated on the foundational axiom that market participants behave as rational agents seeking to maximize their individual utility, a premise now vigorously challenged by behavioral scientists.

en_meaning: Bright blue in color, like a cloudless sky
vi_meaning: Xanh biếc như da trời quang đãng
example_sentence: As the morning fog burned away above the Aegean archipelago, the passengers looked out upon an azure expanse of sea that matched the flawless clarity of the Mediterranean summer sky.

en_meaning: To talk rapidly and continuously in a foolish or incomprehensible way
vi_meaning: Nói lảm nhảm, bập bẹ khó hiểu
example_sentence: In his delirium, the feverish cartographer began to babble disjointed phrases about subterranean caverns and lost rivers, startling the bedside physicians with his incoherent ramblings.

en_meaning: Characterized by drunken revelry or riotous festivity
vi_meaning: Say sưa chè chén, thác loạn cuồng hoan
example_sentence: Puritan chroniclers of the early Massachusetts settlement sternly condemned May Day festivities around the Maypole, depicting the harmless dance as a bacchanalian revel that encouraged debauchery and lawlessness.

en_meaning: To repeatedly ask or annoy someone to do something
vi_meaning: Làm phiền, mè nheo nài nỉ liên tục
example_sentence: Tenacious consumer advocates continued to badger regulatory officials with Freedom of Information requests until the agency finally released the withheld safety trials for the new pesticide.

en_meaning: Humorous or witty conversation; playful banter
vi_meaning: Sự bông đùa, lời trêu đùa dí dỏm
example_sentence: Beneath the sparkling badinage and seemingly effortless repartée that charmed guests at the embassy reception, rival diplomats were subtly probing each other for geopolitical concessions.

en_meaning: To totally bewilder or perplex someone
vi_meaning: Làm bối rối, làm lúng túng khó hiểu
example_sentence: The sudden, synchronized collapse of ancient Bronze Age civilizations across the eastern Mediterranean continues to baffle historians, who have proposed everything from systemic drought to sudden barbarian incursions.

en_meaning: To deliberately annoy or taunt someone; food used to entice prey
vi_meaning: Khiêu khích, chọc tức hoặc nhử mồi
example_sentence: During cross-examination, the cunning prosecutor attempted to bait the defendant into an angry outburst, knowing that a display of volatile temper would destroy his facade of mild innocence.

en_meaning: Threatening harm; menacing or destructive
vi_meaning: Đe dọa tai ương, hiểm ác gở gắm
example_sentence: As the rival clan leaders converged in the castle courtyard to sign the uneasy armistice, they exchanged baleful glares that betrayed a lingering hunger for bloody retribution.

en_meaning: To hesitate or be unwilling to accept an idea or undertaking
vi_meaning: Chùn bước, ngần ngại từ chối thực hiện
example_sentence: While most town councilors supported constructing the civic theater, fiscally conservative members began to balk when architectural revisions escalated the projected budget threefold.

en_meaning: Heavy material used to provide stability to a ship or structure
vi_meaning: Đối trọng dằn thăng bằng, vật làm vững chắc
example_sentence: In eighteenth-century transatlantic trade, merchant ships returning from the West Indies without complete cargoes took aboard river stones and pig iron to serve as ballast, keeping the hulls stable against turbulent Atlantic swells.

en_meaning: A fragrant ointment used to heal or soothe the skin
vi_meaning: Thuốc xoa dịu, niềm an ủi vỗ về
example_sentence: To the shell-shocked veterans returning from the trenches of the Somme, the tranquil seclusion of the English countryside offered a spiritual balm that gradual medical treatments could not replicate.

en_meaning: Characterized by pleasantly warm and mild weather
vi_meaning: Êm dịu, ấm áp dễ chịu
example_sentence: A balmy evening breeze drifted off the gulf waters, carrying the sweet aroma of blooming jasmine and coaxing residents onto their verandas long after dusk had fallen.

en_meaning: So lacking in originality as to be obvious and boring
vi_meaning: Tầm thường, sáo rỗng thiếu độc đáo
example_sentence: Critics lamented that the novelist had abandoned the lyrical originality of her debut work in favor of a formulaic mystery saturated with banal tropes and predictable twists.

en_meaning: To pass back and forth; to exchange words competitively or carelessly
vi_meaning: Bàn tán qua lại, đôi co lời lẽ
example_sentence: Partisan commentators on evening news broadcasts routinely bandy about inflammatory catchphrases without pausing to interrogate the intricate socio-economic facts behind the policy debate.

en_meaning: A cause of continuous great distress, annoyance, or ruin
vi_meaning: Nguyên nhân nỗi khổ, tai họa đeo đẳng
example_sentence: The relentless encroaching of invasive kudzu vine has become the perennial bane of southern foresters, suffocating native oak saplings and blanketing whole woodland hillsides.

en_meaning: Characterized by good-humored, playful, and teasing remarks
vi_meaning: Trêu đùa hóm hỉnh, đùa cợt nhẹ nhàng
example_sentence: The playwright infused the opening act with a brisk, bantering dialogue between the two estranged sisters, masking their simmering childhood resentments beneath sharp, witty barbs.

en_meaning: A sharp projection or a biting, critical remark
vi_meaning: Lời mỉa mai châm chọc, ngạnh nhọn
example_sentence: Though couched in polite academic phraseology, the reviewer's closing barb—questioning whether the historian had even consulted primary archives—inflicted severe damage on the author's professional standing.

en_meaning: A poet, traditionally one who recites epics and associated with a particular culture
vi_meaning: Thi sĩ, người ngâm thơ sử thi
example_sentence: Before epic narratives were transcribed onto vellum, the Gaelic bard traveled from chieftain to chieftain, reciting genealogies and heroic ballads preserved solely through oral tradition.

en_meaning: Extremely ornate, complex, or detailed in style, especially referring to 17th-century art and architecture
vi_meaning: Cầu kỳ hoa mỹ, phong cách Ba-rốc
example_sentence: The interior of the Austrian basilica was an extravagant masterpiece of baroque ornamentation, overwhelming the senses with swirling marble cherubs, trompe-l’œil ceiling frescoes, and heavy gold leaf.

en_meaning: To confer or present an honor, right, or gift
vi_meaning: Ban tặng, trao tặng vinh dự
example_sentence: In gratitude for the scholar’s lifetime spent cataloging indigenous dialects, the sovereign chose to bestow upon him the realm’s highest civilian order of merit.

en_meaning: To formally promise to marry someone
vi_meaning: Hứa hôn, đính ước
example_sentence: In late medieval diplomacy, dynastic treaties frequently required a monarch to betroth his infant heir to a foreign princess, using the sacred promise of marriage to secure military non-aggression.

en_meaning: An overwhelming quantity or continuous delivery of something, such as questions or criticisms
vi_meaning: Loạt dồn dập, trận mưa tới tấp
example_sentence: Facing a relentless barrage of hostile inquiries from reporters regarding offshore tax shelters, the corporate spokesperson abruptly terminated the press conference.

en_meaning: Too poor to produce much or any vegetation; unproductive or infertile
vi_meaning: Cằn cỗi, trơ trụi không sinh sản
example_sentence: Centuries of ruthless deforestation and subsequent topsoil erosion converted the once lush Peloponnesian hillside into a barren landscape where only resilient thistle and scrub could survive.

en_meaning: An improvised barrier erected across a street to prevent or delay the movement of opposing forces
vi_meaning: Chướng ngại vật, hàng rào chắn phòng thủ
example_sentence: Erecting an impromptu barricade of cobblestones, overturned wagons, and timber balks across the boulevard, the student revolutionaries braced themselves for the impending cavalry charge.

en_meaning: A person who exchanges goods or services for other goods or services without using money
vi_meaning: Người đổi chác hàng hóa, người giao thương không tiền mặt
example_sentence: Operating far beyond the frontiers of the empire where imperial mint was useless, the cunning barterer exchanged salt cakes and tempered iron blades for beaver pelts and medicinal roots.

en_meaning: To lie exposed to warmth and light, typically from the sun, for relaxation and pleasure
vi_meaning: Phơi mình tận hưởng sự ấm áp, đắm mình trong vinh quang
example_sentence: Following the international symposium where her clean-energy breakthrough was unveiled, the physicist allowed herself a rare moment to bask in the unanimous acclaim of her colleagues.

en_meaning: A strong defense or a person or institution that upholds particular principles
vi_meaning: Thành trì vững chắc, pháo đài kiên cố
example_sentence: Throughout the upheaval of civil war, the secluded mountaintop monastery remained a steadfast bastion of classical literacy, diligently preserving ancient Greek manuscripts from destruction.

en_meaning: To lessen the force or intensity of; to moderate
vi_meaning: Kìm nén, làm giảm bớt cường độ
example_sentence: Seeing that his harsh reproaches were only driving his grieving daughter further into isolation, the father resolved to bate his sternness and listen with gentle patience.

en_meaning: A small, showy trinket or decoration of little value
vi_meaning: Đồ trang sức hào nhoáng rẻ tiền, vật trang trí vô giá trị
example_sentence: The stoic philosopher urged his disciples to despise the gilded court bauble and the fleeting insignia of worldly office, focusing instead upon the enduring wealth of the soul.

en_meaning: Dealing with sexual matters in a comical or humorously indecent way
vi_meaning: Tục tĩu tếu táo, tiếu lâm dâm dã
example_sentence: In the rowdier scenes of Elizabethan tavern comedies, playwrights indulged in bawdy puns and ribald double entendres that delighted the boisterous groundlings in the pit.

en_meaning: To transmit a signal or to smile radiantly; a long piece of timber
vi_meaning: Cười rạng rỡ, phát tín hiệu rạng ngời
example_sentence: Upon seeing her daughter walk across the stage to receive the university’s highest academic accolade, the matriarch could not help but beam with profound maternal pride.

en_meaning: Feeling or expressing blissful happiness
vi_meaning: Phúc lạc rạng ngời, ngập tràn phúc lành
example_sentence: Even as the storm raged violently against the sanctuary windows, a beatific composure remained upon the countenance of the abbess as she continued her quiet evening prayers.

en_meaning: Supreme blessedness or a state of utmost bliss
vi_meaning: Hạnh phúc tối thượng, phúc lành thiêng liêng
example_sentence: In Dante’s Paradiso, the blessed souls dwell in a state of celestial beatitude, experiencing an ecstatic communion that transcends mortal comprehension.

en_meaning: To dress up or decorate in a gaudy, tasteless manner
vi_meaning: Trang điểm lòe loẹt, diện đồ diêm dúa
example_sentence: Satirizing the vanity of the nouveau riche, the Victorian novelist described how the pompous baroness loved to bedizen herself in gaudy silks and oversized imitation pearls for every public occasion.

en_meaning: To make something dirty, wet, or limp
vi_meaning: Làm lấm lem ướt sũng, làm nhếch nhác
example_sentence: The sudden thunderstorm threatened to bedraggle the velvet capes and feathered tricorn hats worn by the royal guard during the outdoor parade.

en_meaning: A straight direct course between two places
vi_meaning: Đường thẳng tắp, lộ trình ngắn nhất
example_sentence: The moment the dismissal bell rang on the final afternoon of term, triumphant schoolchildren made a frantic beeline for the village swimming pond.

en_meaning: To confuse or perplex someone greatly
vi_meaning: Làm bối rối hoang mang, làm mê muội đầu óc
example_sentence: The convoluted syntax and contradictory clauses of the nineteenth-century tax statute served only to befuddle ordinary merchants attempting to comply with its demands.

en_meaning: To give rise to; to bring about or produce
vi_meaning: Gây ra, sinh ra, làm nảy sinh
example_sentence: Historians of the Weimar Republic observed that punitive postwar reparations served only to beget deep societal resentment, which subsequently fostered violent ideological extremism.

en_meaning: To envy someone's possession or enjoyment of something
vi_meaning: Ghen tị tiếc rẻ, không cam lòng cho hưởng
example_sentence: Though the bitter rivals had contested every grant for decades, neither scientist could begrudge the other the Nobel recognition deserved for such rigorous immunological research.

en_meaning: To charm or enchant someone, sometimes in a deceptive way
vi_meaning: Quyến rũ mê hoặc, đánh lừa ngọt ngào
example_sentence: With melodic cadence and alluring promises of swift prosperity, the charlatan managed to beguile desperate villagers into investing their life savings in nonexistent gold mines.

en_meaning: A huge or monstrous creature, or something of enormous size and power
vi_meaning: Quái vật khổng lồ, thế lực to lớn áp đảo
example_sentence: Small family-owned pharmacies across the nation found it impossible to compete with the wholesale pricing power of the multinational retail behemoth.

en_meaning: To explain or go over something excessively or to an absurd degree
vi_meaning: Giải thích dông dài, nhắc đi nhắc lại quá mức
example_sentence: Conscious that his audience of experienced oncologists already understood tumor staging protocols, the keynote speaker refrained from belaboring basic concepts and focused directly on novel therapies.

en_meaning: Not genuine or true; fake
vi_meaning: Giả mạo, không có thật
example_sentence: Archaeologists quickly identified the purported Phoenician tablet as a bogus artifact, pointing out that its modern chisel marks and anachronistic syntax betrayed a nineteenth-century forgery.

en_meaning: Coming or happening later than should have been the case
vi_meaning: Chậm trễ, muộn màng hơn dự tính
example_sentence: The government’s belated implementation of quarantine protocols failed to stem the contagion, as the pathogen had already infiltrated neighboring provinces weeks before.
